caption_template: papikapi-style low-poly faceted papercraft figure of {subject}, seen in an isometric three-quarter view from the top right corner. Large clean planar facets with pure solid papercraft colors and directional flat-shading only. ABSOLUTELY ZERO black outline strokes, ZERO crease lines, ZERO wireframe, ZERO cartoon borders. SOLID CLOSED GEOMETRIC VOLUMES: all heads, muzzles, jaws, limbs, and bodies are closed solid foldable low-poly polyhedra suitable for papercraft folding. ALL FINE DETAILS ARE FLAT 2D UV TEXTURE DECALS: all teeth, claws, whiskers, nostrils, mouths, spots, stripes, and markings are illustrated completely flat directly onto the facet surfaces as a printed 2D UV texture map, NEVER protruding 3D physical spikes, cutouts, or jagged extrusions. Jaws and muzzles are completely closed blocks with teeth painted flat along the surface. EXACTLY TWO EYES: anatomically correct, exactly two large cute expressive round eyes with circular white catchlight highlights painted flat onto the head facets, never three eyes, never floating eyes. BACKGROUND: completely plain, seamless flat neutral light grey #E5E5E5 background. ABSOLUTELY ZERO SHADOWS: NO floor shadow, NO drop shadow, NO contact shadow, NO ground ambient occlusion anywhere beneath or around the figure.
